summary: As a teenager I always felt more comfortable writing raps instead of school writing. School writing rarely asked me what I thought, felt, or wanted. But in a wrap I could write about anything I wanted to get off my chest #quote -Jamal Cooks
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
As a teenager I always felt more comfortable writing raps instead of school writing. School writing rarely asked me what I thought, felt, or wanted. But in a wrap I could write about anything I wanted to get off my chest
#quote
-Jamal Cooks
